title: Stroke Prediction with COREL classifier Using Synthetic Data
summary: A research project addressing class imbalance in a stroke-prediction dataset by generating synthetic minority-class samples and feeding a balanced dataset into a COREL rule-list classifier for improved stroke prediction. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer (sdv.single_table) to generate the synthetic samples and sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic/get_column_plot to assess them.
